relations.text: 地域の無線事業者のひとつとして競合に含まれる

source.label: Tモバイル 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: In addition, our wireless communications services competitors include numerous smaller and regional providers, including Charter Communications, Inc., Comcast Corporation, EchoStar Corporation (“EchoStar”), Cox Communications, Inc., and Altice USA, Inc., many of which offer no-contract, postpaid and prepaid service plans.

relations.text: 600MHz帯の周波数を買い取る契約を2023年に結んだ
relations.text_en: T-Mobile signed a license purchase agreement with Comcast in 2023 to acquire 600 MHz spectrum

source.label: Tモバイル 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: On September 12, 2023, we entered into a license purchase agreement with Comcast (the “Comcast License Purchase Agreement”), pursuant to which we will acquire spectrum in the 600 MHz band from Comcast in exchange for total cash consideration of between $1.2 billion and $3.3 billion, subject to an application for FCC approval.

relations.text: EQTのファンドとLumosを共同で取得する合弁会社を設立する契約を結んだ
relations.text_en: T-Mobile agreed with an EQT fund to form a joint venture to acquire Lumos

source.label: Tモバイル 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: On April 24, 2024, we entered into a definitive agreement with a fund operated by EQT, EQT Infrastructure VI (“Fund VI”), to establish a joint venture between us and Fund VI to acquire Lumos (“Lumos”), a fiber-to-the-home platform, from EQT’s predecessor fund, EQT Infrastructure III.

relations.text: Metronetを取得する合弁会社を設立する契約を結んだ
relations.text_en: T-Mobile agreed with KKR to form a joint venture to acquire Metronet

source.label: Tモバイル 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: On July 18, 2024, we entered into a definitive agreement with KKR & Co. Inc. to establish a joint venture to acquire Metronet Holdings, LLC and certain of its affiliates (collectively, “Metronet”), a fiber-to-the-home platform.

companies.name: クラウン・キャッスル

relations.text: 2012年にタワーの運営権を譲る契約を結んだ
relations.text_en: T-Mobile conveyed the right to manage and operate tower sites to Crown Castle in 2012

source.label: Tモバイル 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: In 2012, we conveyed to Crown Castle International Corp. (“CCI”) the exclusive right to manage and operate approximately 6,200 tower sites (“CCI Lease Sites”) via a master prepaid lease with site lease terms ranging from 23 to 37 years.
